title: Gemini Model Knowledge Cutoffs & Triage Specification

tier_1a.name: Frontier Post-Cutoff Delta
tier_1a.description: Innovations occurring entirely after the March 2026 cutoff. Mandatory for ALL models (3.1 Pro, 3.6 Flash, 3.7 Flash, 3.8 Flash).
focus: Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform (GEAP) GA and Agent Registry
Gemma 4 12B and distributed Cloud TPU v6e inference
Cloud Run Automated Multi-Region Failover and Serverless MCP Hosting
BigQuery Graph GA, Continuous Queries, and Autonomous Embeddings
Google Cloud Fraud Defense and Cloud CDN Private Bucket Access
Hard Spend Caps on Google Cloud Budgets and Cloud Monitoring Kill Switches

tier_1b.name: Intermediate Delta
tier_1b.description: Post-cutoff for Gemini 3.1 Pro. Validation/refinement tier for 3.6/3.7/3.8 Flash where niche domain knowledge degraded.
focus: Google Model Armor and Workload Identity Federation (WIF)
GKE Inference Gateway and vLLM multi-cluster autoscaling
BigQuery Remote MCP Server and Vector SQL with IVF indexes
LiteRT and LiteRT-LM runtime on Edge/Mobile

tier_2.name: Evergreen Architecture & Foundations
tier_2.description: Pre-cutoff foundation patterns across all models. Consulted on-demand for timeless mathematical thresholds, sizing heuristics, and cost crossover calculations.
focus: BigQuery slot commitments vs on-demand crossover math (690 TB/month)
GKE Autopilot vs Standard compute allocation heuristics
VPC Peering vs Private Service Connect (PSC) scale trade-offs
Cloud SQL performance tuning and read pool replication

gemini-3.1-pro.guidance: High risk of hallucinating obsolete 2024 patterns. Must prioritize Tier 1A and Tier 1B (all items >= 02.25) to overwrite deprecated APIs.

gemini-3.6-flash.guidance: Prioritize Tier 1A (>= 04.26) for post-cutoff features. Consult Tier 1B when working with specialized infrastructure (ADK 1.0, Model Armor, GKE Inference Gateway).

gemini-3.7-flash.guidance: Prioritize Tier 1A (>= 04.26) for modern 2026 architectures. Consult Tier 1B for specialized GCP agent and GKE patterns.

gemini-3.8-flash.guidance: Prioritize Tier 1A (>= 04.26) for all Google Cloud architecture and AI agent tasks.
